speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She said, when you write, say something. I have written a list. A list is not a letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Something is the friar. He says she is too quick, and he is not heeded, and saying it does not mend it. That is Susanna's, and it is still on the table upstairs. It is not sealed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house is still the house. I am not putting a sum on it. The fourth act can wait for a sheet I am willing to send.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The strap still wants shortening. The back is still the back. I am not mending either of them tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow is the fair. Monday the doors open. This page is not a part in either.
